title: Processing Machines
subtitle: Built on a chassis
text:
Electric Furnace: 20 FE/t, normal smelting.
Rolling Mill: 20 FE/t, rods or casings.
Crusher: 20 FE/t, ores give 2 dusts.
Sawmill: 20 FE/t, a log gives 6 planks.
Alloy Smelter: 30 FE/t, Alloy Furnace recipes in half the time.

Each machine has its own assembly; the assembly decides what the chassis becomes. Feed FE in on any side. Use the screwdriver on a side to push outputs out of it, or pull them with a pipe; see Auto-output.
caption: Any side can take FE, items or an output port
